subtitle: Ranked by number of individual NSEA team records held across LC (meters) and SCY (yards). Tap a swimmer to see every record on their card.
disclaimer: It's built entirely from the official LC and SCY team record sheets, which only capture the single fastest swim per event, per age group. Results that never became a record — or any results missing from those exports — aren't reflected here, so the true all-time leaderboard could look different.
